messages:
jamie: Heads-up—planning to open the v2 deprecation migration window next Tuesday. Quick checklist: SDK shim release, opt-in header for compatibility testing, and the telemetry event we want to gate on. Who can own each?
priya: I can own telemetry. I'll add the event name and dashboards. Asking: do we want both success/failure + latency buckets? :thinking_face: 
alex: I can take the SDK shim. Plan is to ship a patch that sends X-Redwood-Compat: v1 by default and exposes an opt-in flag to opt into v2. Will publish migration notes.
oliver: I can handle canary routing and the region slices. Proposed rollout: 5% global, then 25% in us-west, then full in 48h if metrics look good.
jamie: Good. Telemetry requirements: we want a single boolean event migration.attempt plus tags: sdk_version, client_id, region, success. Priya: can you add a latency histogram too?
priya: Yep — adding: migration.attempt (bool), migration.lat_ms (histogram), migration.reason (enum). Dashboard will show migration.success_rate by sdk_version and region.
alex: SDK shim snippet I plan to ship:```js
// client opts in to v2 headers
const client = new RedwoodClient({ compat: 'v1' });
client.request(...);
// new flag: { enableV2: true } toggles header to X-Redwood-Compat: v2
```
jamie: Also want a short curl we can share in migration guide for QA teams. alex can you add that to the PR?
alex: will do. Also adding a feature flag so platform can flip the header from our side for quick rollbacks.
jamie: deploy-bot: can you schedule canary for next Tue 09:00 UTC to match the migration window?
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy for v2-compat-shim on 2026-03-24T09:00:00Z to slice=5% (us-west pref). See run 87421. :white_check_mark: 
sdk-team-bot: Heads-up: publishing minor SDK patch to npm and PyPI. Release notes will include: opt-in flag, telemetry opt-out instructions, and migration guide link.
oliver: Quick question—what's our abort threshold? I suggest abort if migration.success_rate < 98% OR median migration.lat_ms increases > 30% vs baseline for two consecutive 5m windows. Thoughts?
priya: sounds reasonable. I'll wire an alert that pings #incidents and the owners if either condition triggers.
jamie: owners: telemetry=priya, sdk=alex, routing=oliver, PM oversight=jamie. I'll create the migration checklist doc and link it in the PR.
alex: pinging @sdk-maintainers for final review. PR will include curl example and rollback steps.
priya: I added the dashboard and a sample Alert query to the PR comments.
jamie: OK team — aim to have everything merged 24h before the window. If we see any blocker, mark the PR with "migration-blocker" label so we can triage.
oliver: noted. I'll hold the canary toggle until we get green telemetry.
jamie: thanks — closing the loop here. If anyone needs extra time, shout now. :v:
